# N047 — Linear and angular tolerance for same-surface face merging not user-specifiable

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.4 (`12-4-tolerance`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-4-tolerance/N047.stp`](../../step-examples/12-4-tolerance/N047.stp)  

## Sources
- OCCT MANTIS#0027729

## Description

Same-domain face-merge logic uses fixed linear and angular tolerances. For a coarse-mesh-derived shape (linear tolerance ~0.1 mm), the fixed thresholds are too tight and merges fail; for a high-precision shape they are too loose and over-merge.

## Reproducer recipe

Two coplanar faces with native vertex tolerance ~0.1 mm, sharing a common edge. Algorithm uses fixed 1e-7 threshold and refuses to merge.

## Expected kernel behavior

tolerance-using algorithms accept caller-supplied tolerances or read them from the input shape; never hard-code.
